user.title: AdaptiveCharge
user.description: Give this charger a name, then choose how your net power is measured.

net_power.title: Net Power Sensor
net_power.description: Select the sensor that measures net grid power (positive = import, negative = export). Enable 'Invert' if your sensor uses reversed sign convention.

consumption_production.title: Consumption & Production Sensors
consumption_production.description: Select the sensors for house consumption and solar production.

charger.title: Charger Sensors
charger.description: Select sensors for EV power consumption and grid voltage.

vehicle.title: Vehicle Entities
vehicle.description: Select entities for vehicle presence, cable connection, and current range.

range.title: Charge Buffer, Hysteresis & Default Limit
range.description: Set the charge buffer, range hysteresis, and the default charge limit to reset to when the car disconnects. Hysteresis must be ≤ buffer.

data.low_power_threshold_pct: Low Power Threshold (%) — force charge when battery is below this level (0 = disabled)
data.low_power_forecast_kwh: Low Power Forecast Minimum (kWh) — skip force charge when solar forecast exceeds this value

surplus_settings.title: Surplus Charging Thresholds & Current Limits
surplus_settings.description: Set surplus start/stop thresholds and the min/max charge current. Min current must be ≤ max current.

charge_window.title: Night Charging Window
charge_window.description: Set the start and end times for the night charging window. The 'Charge Tonight' switch activates charging at the start time and auto-resets at the end time.

solar_optional.title: Solar Sensor (Optional)
solar_optional.description: Optionally select a solar generation sensor and/or one or more forecast sensors (e.g. Solcast, Open-Meteo Solar). Multiple forecast sensors are summed.

actuators_optional.title: Actuators (Optional)
actuators_optional.description: Optionally select the charge switch, charge current number, and charge limit number entities. The charge limit number controls the vehicle's charge limit percentage.

advanced.title: Advanced Settings
advanced.description: Fine-tune timing parameters for the charging control algorithm.

utility_meters.title: Utility Meter Periods
utility_meters.description: Select which periods to track and whether to split missed solar by cause.

error.stop_exceeds_start: Stop threshold must be ≤ start threshold.
error.min_exceeds_max: Minimum current must be ≤ maximum current.

error.stop_exceeds_start: Stop threshold must be ≤ start threshold.
error.min_exceeds_max: Minimum current must be ≤ maximum current.
